apps.name: Minecraft Story Mode Season 1
apps.subtitle: Minecraft story mode season 1 (instructions in desc).
apps.localizedDescription:
I did not rapckage this ipa, it is found on https://archive.org/details/telltale-games-ios-archive and to get all of the episodes, follow these instructions



1 - if you are jailbroke, install the ipa as normal. if not, use sidestore and livecontainer and install with livecontainer

2 - open the app and after it shows the main menu, kill the app

3 - open fila (or the livecontainer in files app) and open the data for the minecraft storymode app

3a -- filza: /var/mobile/Containers/Data/Application/ and find the minecraft folder

3b -- Livecontianer: /LiveContainer/Data/Application and find the correct folder for minecraft storymode



4 - open the Documents folder and delete everything inside (you can zip its contents and save it somewhere safe if you want a backup)

5 - download and unzip this file https://archive.org/download/telltale-games-ios-archive/Telltale%20Games/Minecraft%20Story%20Mode%20-%20Season%201/Episode%20Data/EPISODES%20(Season%20One).zip



6 - open that extracted folder and open Documents (you can delete the __MACOSX or whatever folder), copy its contents and paste them in the minecraft app Documents folder

7 - respring (if you can) and open the minecraft storymode app and all the episodes should say Purchased and Installed, if not, repeat steps 4-7
